# doit_customer_notifications (Data Source)

Organization-wide cost-anomaly notification configs, delivered by email, Slack and Microsoft Teams. Requires the Manage settings permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    doit = {
      source = "doitintl/doit"
    }
  }
}

# List all organization-wide cost-anomaly notifications (not paginated).
# Requires the "Manage settings" permission.
data "doit_customer_notifications" "all" {}

locals {
  # Notifications that also post to Slack.
  slack_notifications = [
    for n in data.doit_customer_notifications.all.items : n
    if length(n.destinations.slack_channels) > 0
  ]
}

output "notification_names" {
  value = [for n in data.doit_customer_notifications.all.items : n.name]
}

output "slack_notification_ids" {
  value = [for n in local.slack_notifications : n.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Cost-anomaly notification configs for the tenant, ordered by `createTime` ascending, then by `id` ascending. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the config was created. `null` only on a dry-run create.
- `destinations` (Attributes) Delivery targets. Always includes `emails`, `slackChannels`, and `teamsChannels`. Unused lists are empty arrays. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--destinations))
- `etag` (String) Current strong ETag as bare SHA-256 hex. The `ETag` response header and `If-Match` wrap this value in double quotes. Send that quoted form unchanged on update or delete. `null` only on a dry-run create.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned notification id. `null` only on a dry-run create.
- `name` (String) Display name of the notification (max 200 characters). The stored name is trimmed.
- `settings` (Attributes) Subscribed notification settings. Only `costAnomalies` is accepted; any other notification type is rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--settings))
- `update_time` (String) When the config was last changed. `null` only on a dry-run create.

<a id="nestedatt--items--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.destinations`

Read-Only:

- `emails` (List of String) Email addresses that receive the notification, in the order sent. The array is required; an empty array means email is unused. Omitting the array is rejected. At least one of `emails`, `slackChannels`, or `teamsChannels` must be non-empty. Addresses are stored and returned lowercase. A duplicate or an invalid email is `422`.
- `slack_channels` (List of String) Slack channel ids for Slack channels that receive the notification, in the order sent. The array is required; an empty array means Slack is unused. Omitting the array is rejected. At least one of `emails`, `slackChannels`, or `teamsChannels` must be non-empty. Accepts a public channel, a shared channel, or a private channel the caller is a member of when the DoiT app is also in that channel. A service account cannot add a private channel and receives the same `422` as an id outside the tenant. The caller supplies the id; this API does not look channels up. A duplicate or an id outside the tenant is `422` without saying whether it exists elsewhere. After a channel is accepted, get and list keep returning that id even if the channel is later deleted, archived, or disconnected. That does not mean delivery still works.
- `teams_channels` (List of String) Microsoft Teams conversation ids for Microsoft Teams channels that receive the notification, in the order sent. The array is required; an empty array means Teams is unused. Omitting the array is rejected. At least one of `emails`, `slackChannels`, or `teamsChannels` must be non-empty. A duplicate or an id outside the tenant is `422` without saying whether it exists elsewhere. A Teams id is also `422` when the tenant has no Teams entitlement. After a channel is accepted, get and list keep returning that id even if the channel is later deleted, archived, or disconnected, or the tenant loses Teams entitlement. That does not mean delivery still works.


<a id="nestedatt--items--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.settings`

Read-Only:

- `cost_anomalies` (Attributes) Cost-anomaly notification settings: minimum severity, excess-cost threshold, allocation scope, and
optional resend controls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies))

<a id="nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.settings.cost_anomalies`

Read-Only:

- `allocations` (Attributes) Allocation scope for cost-anomaly notifications. `ids` are allocation ids from `GET
/analytics/v1/allocations`. An id outside the caller's tenant is rejected with `422` without saying
whether it exists elsewhere.

`mode: all` means every allocation with anomaly detection enabled, including anomalies that are not
tied to an allocation, and it carries an empty `ids`. `include` and `exclude` require at least one
id. `mode: all` with a non-empty `ids`, and `include` or `exclude` with an empty `ids`, are rejected
with `422`. `ids` are an ordered list: the server stores and returns them in the order sent, and it does
not sort or drop entries. A duplicate id is rejected with `422`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations))
- `min_excess_cost` (Attributes) Minimum excess cost, as Money. Notify when excess cost is above this amount, not total spend.
`100.00` USD means $100. `currency` must be `USD`; any other currency is rejected with `422`. A
negative amount is rejected with `422`. A fractional amount is rejected with `422` (`100.99` is not a
whole number of dollars). `100` and `100.00` are both accepted. `0` and `0.00` are accepted. Amounts
above 1,000,000,000 whole dollars, and forms such as `Inf`, exponents, a leading `+`, or underscores,
are rejected with `422`. Responses return the amount as `"100.00"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost))
- `min_severity` (String) `warning` — warning and above. `critical` — critical only. There is no `information` or `all` value; a write of `all` is rejected with `422`. Clients may send only `warning` or `critical`. Responses return only `warning` or `critical`. A missing or empty stored severity (console "All severity levels") is returned as `warning`. `critical` is stored and returned as `critical`.
- `repeat` (Attributes) Resend controls for an active cost anomaly. Omit the whole `repeat` object when neither control is
set. An empty object is rejected with `422`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat))

<a id="nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.settings.cost_anomalies.allocations`

Read-Only:

- `ids` (List of String) Allocation ids, in the order sent. A read returns that same order. A duplicate id is rejected
with `422`. Empty when `mode` is `all`. Non-empty when `mode` is `include` or `exclude`.
- `mode` (String) `all` — every allocation with anomaly detection enabled (and unallocated anomalies). `include` — only the listed ids. `exclude` — all enabled allocations except the listed ids. `all` cannot be sent with a non-empty `ids`. `include` and `exclude` cannot be sent with an empty `ids`.


<a id="nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.settings.cost_anomalies.min_excess_cost`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Decimal monetary amount at ISO 4217 minor-unit precision (string).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.


<a id="nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.settings.cost_anomalies.repeat`

Read-Only:

- `every_hours` (Number) Resend until the anomaly is inactive, every N hours (1–24).
- `when_cost_grows` (Attributes) Resend when the anomaly's cost grows. At least one of `percentIncrease` or `minIncrease` is required.
An object with only `withinHours`, only `match`, or neither amount is rejected with `422`.

- both `percentIncrease` and `minIncrease` present → `match` is
  required (`or` or `and`)
- exactly one of `percentIncrease` or `minIncrease` present → omit
  `match` (percentage-only or value-only)
- neither amount present → rejected with `422`

`percentIncrease` is an integer percent (`10` means 10 percent) and must be at least 1. Omit
`withinHours` when the time window is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows))

<a id="nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows`

Read-Only:

- `match` (String) How to combine percent and dollar growth when both are set. Required when both amounts are present; omit when only one amount is present.
- `min_increase` (Attributes) Minimum cost growth that triggers a resend, as Money. Must be a positive whole number of dollars.
`150.00` USD means $150. `currency` must be `USD`; any other currency is rejected with `422`. `0`,
`0.00`, and a negative amount are rejected with `422`. A fractional amount is rejected with `422`
(`150.99` is not a whole number of dollars). `150` and `150.00` are both accepted. Amounts above
1,000,000,000 whole dollars, and forms such as `Inf`, exponents, a leading `+`, or underscores, are
rejected with `422`. Responses return the amount as `"150.00"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase))
- `percent_increase` (Number) Minimum percent cost increase that triggers a resend. `10` means 10 percent. Must be greater than 0.
- `within_hours` (Number) Optional window in hours for the growth check (1–24).

<a id="nestedatt--items--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows.min_increase`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Decimal monetary amount at ISO 4217 minor-unit precision (string).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.
